name: silicondevine.js
description: Crystal tensor visualization for PyTorch computational graphs

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts
scripts.test: node tests/core.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py && python tests/generate_extended.py && node tests/extended.mjs && node tests/llm.mjs
scripts.examples: python examples/export_models.py && python tests/export_llm.py && python tests/export_official.py
